# PLAN — iteration 4
## Current state assessment
The verified incumbent remains timing-infeasible at WNS −2.766 ns, with WHS +0.168 ns; the objective is still timing progress toward closure. The advisor trial identifies an output path from a `y_out` replica register through an OBUF, while the original baseline’s critical path was a deep DSP cascade. Iterations 1 and 2 were accepted; iteration 3 was rejected, but its failed proposal is unspecified. The current top already declares the required `// @latency 1`.

## Hypothesis
Packing the existing registered `y_out` bits into 7-series I/O blocks may shorten the output path and improve setup WNS without changing its cycle behavior.

## Instruction for generator
Apply Xilinx `(* IOB = "TRUE" *)` to the existing `y_out` output register. Keep its assignment, synchronous reset, and all pipeline registers unchanged so the output remains registered with identical cycle behavior. Preserve the parameterized symmetric and general coefficient paths; retain the `// @latency 1` annotation.
